fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Four Evangelists as the Royal Stars", "body": "Dylan Saccoccio argues that the four evangelists are the four royal stars of the fixed signs: Luke with the bull is Aldebaran in Taurus, Mark with the lion is Regulus in Leo, John with the eagle is Antares in Scorpio, and Matthew with the angel is Fomalhaut, the star in the southern fish's mouth beneath Aquarius. He reads Ezekiel 1:10 and Revelation 4:7 as listing the beasts out of seasonal order, points to the Wheel of Fortune card's four corners, and notes that the two equinox stars glow red while the two solstice stars shine white."}, {"title": "Venus, Mary and the Sea", "body": "Moving from Saint Mark to Venice, Dylan hears Venus in the city's name and traces her to Aphrodite, the foam-sprung goddess, and to Rhode, the sea wife of Helios. In his reading, Mary comes from mare, the Latin sea, so hymns like Ave Maris Stella hail a star of the sea, and he connects Rhodian sea law to modern maritime admiralty law. Their slides of Saint Mark's Basilica show its golden lion, which Dylan reads as a monument to Regulus, the summer king star."}, {"title": "The Sphinx, Hermes and Lord Eight", "body": "Dylan treats the Sphinx as a key: the body of a bull, the paws of a lion, the wings of an eagle and the head of a man give the same four fixed signs, which he takes as evidence that the Egyptian symbolism is younger than claimed. He links Oedipus becoming king at Thebes to solving that riddle, calls Hermes Lord Eight through Hermopolis, and adds Yod He Vav He to 26, reducing to eight. The analemma's figure eight joins the pattern, and Dylan says numbers are a further layer of language rather than fortune telling."}, {"title": "Four Horsemen as the Four Seasons", "body": "Reading Revelation 6 aloud, Chance and Dylan walk through each seal as one season in Dylan's interpretation. The lamb is Aries opening spring, and the white rider with a bow and crown is Sagittarius beside Corona Australis. The red rider with a great sword is the scorching summer sun, which Dylan links to King Herod beheading John the Baptist. The black rider holding balances is Libra and the autumn harvest, where a failed reaping means famine, and the pale rider followed by Hades is winter, which Dylan connects to Persephone, Virgo and the star Spica."}, {"title": "Reality Over Mysteria", "body": "Chance describes the old symbolism as a sky clock, where seeing a red star once told people what time of year it was. He warns against mysteria, which he describes as ideas about ideas cut off from nature, and recommends Michael Tsarion's Disciples of the Mysterium. He rejects the idea of a fallen world, and Dylan answers that evil is a choice rather than something people are born with. Dylan calls the popular law of attraction a new age perversion, the caduceus is read as a picture of the spine and nervous system, and Chance sums the strand up as reality is salvation."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: A full visual presentation with Chance and Dylan Saccoccio decoding one of the oldest and most persistent patterns hidden in scripture, mythology, and sacred architecture: the four royal stars of the fixed zodiac.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In this session: how Regulus, Aldebaran, Antares, and Fomalhaut map directly onto the four evangelists, the four horsemen of the Apocalypse, and the four fixed signs of the zodiac, the Venetian lion and Saint Mark's Basilica as a monument to Leo and Regulus, Venus and the Virgin Mary as two names for the same maritime goddess, the sea as the root of maritime law and the Virgin of the Sea, the Riddle of the Sphinx as an astro-theological key, Hermopolis and Hermes as Lord Eight, the Yod-He-Vav-He name of God decoded numerologically, the tetractis, the hexagram and the cube as the architecture of the Abrahamic symbol system, and Moses as the Nile and the nine Muses as the nine months before the flood.
